notes:
Early PLG inbound from solo dev / micro-startup building a UX research assistant (chat + summarization) for small product teams. Self-serve signup and API key creation; no AE outreach yet.

Timeline:
- 2026-02-15: User signed up via landing page, claimed free credits, created API key.
- 2026-02-16: Ran smoke tests (chat prompts + embeddings for doc similarity). Reported average latency ~180-350ms for short chats; happy with response quality.
- 2026-02-20: Attended community webinar; commented about rate limits and wanting predictable billing. (left a message in chat)
- 2026-02-25: In-app feedback: "Works great for prototypes - need cost predictability to scale". Also asked if private deployment ever needed - currently public cloud only.
- 2026-02-28: Auto email follow-up (billing estimate) triggered; user replied asking for sample monthly bill for 5k sessions/month.

Use-case / requirements summary:
- Workloads: chat assistant for UX feedback, doc embeddings for search + summarization. Low concurrency but occasional bursts during product tests.
- Targets: latency desirable <500ms for short chats, throughput low (hundreds/day), cost-sensitive - wants predictable per-month pricing estimate.
- Model preferences: prefers open-family models (LLM variants) to control cost; wants guidance on quality vs cost for hosted models.
- Routing/fallback: would like automatic fallback to smaller/cheaper model during spikes.
- Security/compliance: minimal today (SOC2 desirable), no SSO/SAML yet. Data residency not required.

Quotes from founder: "Love the quick dev experience - main blocker is predictable cost so we can include in pricing to customers."

Next steps / recommended actions:
- Send concise sample monthly billing scenarios for 1k / 5k / 20k sessions with common model choices (hosted_api).
- Offer suggestion doc re: batching, caching, and model selection to reduce unit cost.
- Trigger in-app survey to capture expected monthly volume and rate-limit needs.
- Keep AE unassigned for now; flag if usage crosses free-credit threshold.

Linked artifacts: pricing estimate draft in Drive, support ticket for rate-limit question (HUBSUP-3421).
